about.title: About KA Audit Ltd
about.lead: KA Audit Ltd provides independent audit and professional advisory services to businesses operating across a range of sectors in Bulgaria. The firm's capabilities include audit and assurance, accounting, tax, financial advisory and consulting, combining local market knowledge with experienced professional expertise.
about.body: As a member firm of Parker Russell International, KA Audit Ltd can support clients with both domestic requirements and matters involving international business and cross-border activity.
